report_identity.report_title: XINGYE WULIAN SERVICE GROUP CO. LTD. Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group provides property management and value-added services, property engineering services, property development, online group-buying, charging pile and clubhouse services mainly in Chinese Mainland.
business_overview.revenue_model: Property management services are mostly recurring service fees; property engineering and clubhouse/charging pile/other services add project and ancillary service revenue. Property management and value-added services mainly require customer prepayment, while property engineering and clubhouse services are generally on credit within 30 days.
business_notes: Independent third parties contributed RMB367.433 million revenue, related parties RMB43.154 million.
The Group is incorporated in Cayman Islands and listed in Hong Kong, but mainly operates in the PRC.
